Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649951 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
